== Biography ==
He was born in Curitiba - PR.

== Trivia ==
<tabber>
General Trivia=
===General Trivia===
* Known for his {{ci|lucian}}, {{ci|zeri}} and {{ci|ashe}}.
* Portraited as {{ci|zeri}} in the [[Worlds 2024]] [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5FrhtahQiRc anthem], with references to his '''"Bot Gap"''' moment against [[Fnatic]] during [[Worlds 2022]].<ref>[https://maisesports.com.br/worlds-2024-riot-colocou-um-easter-egg-especial-para-brance-em-heavy-is-the-crown/ Worlds 2024: Riot colocou um easter egg especial para Brance em “Heavy is the Crown”] ''maisesports.com.br''</ref>
** He had a winrate of 88.9% with the champion in 2024.
* [[Liiv SANDBOX]]'s CEO considered offering Brance a test in '''LCK CL''' during his bootcamp in Korea in 2023 and during the trials they started to call him "'''Samba Bomber'''".<ref>[https://twitter.com/inmochung/status/1727005160684265542 Inmochung's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* Got the first pentakill of the [[League of Legends Championship of The Americas|LTA]] as {{ci|Zeri}}.<ref>[https://x.com/LTASul/status/1883615520496419096 LTA Sul's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* Despite having played a lot with {{ci|ashe}} and having over 1 million mastery points in his account, he said in a stream that he doesn't like playing the champion, and that it only helped him climb from Gold to Master before he was a professional player.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vSDhnuVdYiE Brance DESABAFA sobre CARREIRA e INICIO na LOUD] ''youtube.com''</ref>
|-|
Non-League-related Trivia=
=== Non-League-related Trivia ===
* He's nicknamed "Tigrinho" (Little Tiger) due to his cousin using the nickname "Leãozinho" (Little Lion) when playing soloqueue and he decided to use the nickname "Tigrinho C4" to play. <ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YKgKofuLdRI&t=90 MC Brance - A Promessa (part. Pedro Qualy) | CBLOL 2022 - 2ª Etapa (Portuguese)] ''youtube.com''</ref> 
* He likes rap a lot and he participated in a street rap battle, which became a meme in the community. <ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YKgKofuLdRI&t=363 MC Brance - A Promessa (part. Pedro Qualy) | CBLOL 2022 - 2ª Etapa (Portuguese)] ''youtube.com''</ref> 
** Due to that, he was invited and participated in a rap song with brazilian rapper '''Pedro Qualy'''. <ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YKgKofuLdRI MC Brance - A Promessa (part. Pedro Qualy) | CBLOL 2022 - 2ª Etapa] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* He revealed that following the [[wikipedia:en:Haikyu!!|Haikyu!!]] effect while playing for [[RED Canids]] in [[CBLOL 2024 Split 2]] the team chose the game [[wikipedia:en:Valheim|Valheim]] for the group activity of the split.<ref>[https://x.com/ilhadaslendas/status/1883922391098937816 Ilha das Lendas' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
|-|
Notable Achievements=
=== Notable Achievements ===
* He got known internationally after winning a 2v2 against [[Fnatic]]'s botlane at [[Worlds 2022]] and showing "Bot Gap" written on his arm. He afterwards won the game.<ref>[https://ge.globo.com/esports/lol/noticia/2023/02/23/cblol-2023-brance-fala-de-bot-gap-viralizado-e-boa-fase-do-fluxo.ghtml CBLOL 2023: Brance fala de "bot gap" viralizado e boa fase do Fluxo (Portuguese)] ''twitter.com''</ref>
|-|
